1.title: Trump Fired His Inspectors General. Their Replacements Have a Different Mission.
1.summary: President Trump is installing his allies in the offices of inspector general, which are meant to provide independent government oversight.

2.title: A Missile Alert Half a World Away Interrupts Court Hearing at Guantánamo
2.summary: A possible expert witness was hurried off a video feed after an emergency alert in Dubai, just south of the Strait of Hormuz, a flashpoint in the U.S.-Iran war.

3.title: Judge Allows Limited Testing in Trump Plan to Paint Eisenhower Building White
3.summary: A federal judge ruled that initial preparatory steps, including testing out paints on the building’s gray granite exterior, could proceed for now.

4.title: Lindsay Clancy begged for help before her children's killings, mother-in-law testifies
4.summary: Lindsay Clancy has admitted killing her daughter and two sons but has pleaded not guilty to murder, saying she was experiencing postpartum psychosis.

5.title: Israel Strikes Air Base in Syria, Drawing Ire From the U.S.
5.summary: American and Syrian officials said Israel carried out the attack, the latest in a series of military interventions in Syria over the past two years.

6.title: Earthquake rocks Spain's historic Granada, injuring three
6.summary: A number of buildings and cars are damaged in the historic city, and the world famous Alhambra palace has temporarily closed.
